name: Multi-Board Fabrication Export
description: Exports separate gerber and drill outputs, and a zip, for each board marked out by a rule area on Edge.Cuts.
description_full: Marks out each board on a panel with a rule area on the Edge.Cuts layer carrying a board_name custom property, then produces gerber and drill files for that board only, puts them in a folder named after it, and zips them. Plot settings come from the board's saved plot parameters; drill options come from the drill dialog's remembered values, falling back to kicad-cli defaults. Requires KiCad's IPC API server to be enabled.
